# Supplied V3.1 reference documents

These five design documents are unchanged copies of the October NDS handover's
`reference_sources`. They contain the dictionary, mapping workbook, ordered-map
archive and proposed country displays. They contain no participant responses.
The independent QA golden cases are in `../SCORING_GOLDEN.json`.

`../v31_sources.json` records the original SHA256 values for all six files.
Tests verify those bytes before using them. The contract records relative source
names so moving a checkout does not change its hash. Only source path metadata
was normalised. Item meanings, source hashes and provisional formulas are unchanged.
The local Git attributes retain the CSVs' supplied BOM and CRLF bytes.

These documents do not establish deployed REDCap metadata, scientific approval
or source/destination permission. Those remain separate DE04 and later inputs.
